content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone know how to find out the serial number of a [product_name]? Is there a way to do this with [product_name] [version_no]? The device is already installed and I would prefer not to remove it just to read the serial number from the housing. Currently, I have an issue with two networked [product_name] devices and [company_name] has requested the serial numbers. I was able to read the serial from the packaging of one, but not the other. Is it possible to read the serial number without uninstalling the unit, perhaps using [product_name] [version_no]? Thanks / best regards [user_name]

The serial number of the [product_name] cannot be read via software. Software access only provides the MAC address, IP address, and firmware version. The serial number is located on the device's packaging and on the right side of the housing.
Is it possible to obtain the serial number of [product_name] hardware using [product_name] [version_no]?
As far as I know, this is not possible.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking a way to view the serial number of an installed [product_name] via software like [product_name] [version_no], aiming to avoid physically removing the device. It is clarified that software can provide network or firmware information, but not the hardware serial number, causing challenges for maintenance and support situations.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to retrieve hardware serial numbers of [product_name] devices remotely using software, rather than having to access the physical device.
